channels.title: Send alerts by
channels.description: How shoppers get back-in-stock and price-drop alerts, through Notifications, to the email or phone of their sign-in.

guests.title: Guests may ask for alerts
guests.description: Without signing in, with the contact guests are known by (Checkout: Guests check out by: a phone, an email address or either): the product page asks for it.

targetPrice.title: Shoppers may name a price
targetPrice.description: The product page asks for an optional price with a price-drop alert: the alert is sent only once the price is at or under it.

stopUrl.title: Alert stop page
stopUrl.description: The page each alert message links to for stopping alerts ({stopUrl}): a path or https address with {token}, for example /alerts/stop/{token}. Empty or without {token}: /alerts/unsubscribe/{token} on your domain. Place the alerts_stop widget on that page.
